purpose: Configure the optional Helix AI integration, explicit mode and feature opt-ins, provider credentials, daily cap, and audited usage.
primaryGoal: Review and explicitly save a safe off/local/cloud configuration without silently restoring features or losing other settings or provider credentials.

dataSources.behavior: Shared ['settings'] cache; AbortSignal forwarded. AISettings derives trust and mirrors only its AI subtree into a reviewable draft.
Requires an existing cached settings document, merges the AI patch with that document, invalidates/broadcasts settings and emits mutation toasts. No mutation exercised.
Available during off-mode opt-in. Typed 422 rejection becomes inline outcome; other failures are caught by the provider form. Empty key omitted to retain saved credentials. No probe exercised.

Shared ['ai','usage','today'] polling query with AbortSignal. Status strip, usage card and cap bar share cache; multiple consumers are not evidence of duplicate HTTP requests. Uses calling-subject audited UTC-day totals.
Page omits since; handler defaults to rolling seven days. Rows sorted locally by audited cost then calls. Historical data retained independently of recent attribution.
Newest sampled provider/model per feature, explicitly not a breakdown of seven-day spend; separate query and trust state.
Canonical stable IDs, names, explanations and default-off metadata; filter categories are presentation-only. Registry generation and backend feature behavior were not exercised.

sourceObserved: AISettings mode grid stacks below sm and becomes three columns at sm.
Provider inputs stack below sm; provider-plus-usage bento becomes three columns at xl with provider spanning two.
Feature groups retain all rows, search and explanations; row grid becomes two columns at lg.
Spend list stacks below sm; header badges and save footer use flex-wrap.
PageLayout provides w-full/min-w-0 and a container context; feature grids still use viewport breakpoints.

findings.detail: Restore action row has no wrapping/stacking and neither action opts into wrapLabel. Long translated action labels must share a narrow panel row.
findings.fix: Use responsive stacking or flex-wrap and existing Button.wrapLabel for both actions, preserving both confirm and decline and complete archive preview.
findings.confidence: high source evidence; actual overflow unverified

findings.detail: Both validation rows (246 and 342) use Stack direction=row without wrapping; Stack's default row renderer does not wrap. Long returned validation messages compete with action width.
findings.fix: Pass existing className flex-wrap with min-width handling or stack the result below the action at narrow widths; preserve full feedback text and Validate behavior.
findings.confidence: high source evidence; actual clipping unverified

responsive.viewportTesting: Unverified at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, narrow shell allocations, RTL and 200% text.

sourceObserved: Mode group has localized aria-labelledby and native shared radio cards.
Each feature toggle has a localized accessible label and resolvable description ID; disclosure actions supply aria-expanded/controls.
Search is labeled; category actions use aria-pressed; feature count uses role=status.
Validation feedback uses role=status; initial failures use alert/retry; decorative icons are hidden.
FadeIn delegates reduced motion to the current shared preference owner.

findings.detail: More/Less detail explicitly requests min-h-6 while size=sm keeps shared h-9, so min-h-6 is not proof of a 24px computed target. The sm disclosure/category controls (178) still request a 36px rather than 44px minimum target.
findings.fix: Use existing Button sizing/classes to ensure at least 44px reachable touch targets or document measured spacing exceptions; retain aria-controls/expanded and all explanations. Do not add a second Button primitive.
findings.confidence: high source size evidence; computed dimensions and WCAG spacing compliance unverified

findings.detail: Save communicates pending state with disabled and changed copy but does not pass Button.loading, whose shared implementation supplies aria-busy. Provider validation follows the same copy-only pending pattern.
findings.fix: Use existing loading prop or explicit aria-busy with existing copy and disabled behavior; do not add parallel pending-state implementations.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard, screen reader, focus visibility/restoration, effective contrast, forced colors and touch behavior unverified; no browser or accessibility runner exercised.

states.initialLoading: AISettings stays mounted; settings-derived summary becomes loading/unknown. Mode controls initialize safely off; Save disabled while settings isLoading. No page spinner should be added.
states.empty: No calls is distinct from missing data in AIUsageCard; spend list and generated-registry/search misses have explanations. Registry-empty branch exists.
states.error: Settings fatal failure uses QueryError with refetch. Usage/breakdown initial failures have independent retry; validation gives inline fail outcome; save uses mutation toast.
states.retained: deriveDataState/useDataState retain values on refresh failures. Configured forms and independently retained spend/attribution remain visible.
states.off: Provider/feature/usage panels are intentionally conditional on local mode; saved off guard prevents usage polling before saved opt-in. This is consent gating, not a null-data section-loss finding.
states.partial: Recent provider/model attribution failure does not remove seven-day spend totals; sampled context is explicitly distinguished from the aggregate.

findings.detail: Settings stale rendering does not use isRefreshBlocked, updatedAt or retry. Usage/spend stale messages state that refresh failed even when deriveDataState can mark a paused/offline refresh stale without an error (AIUsageCard:97; AIFeatureSpendPanel:94).
findings.fix: Forward existing trust evidence into current DataStateNotice/message/retry controls, distinguish paused/offline from failed refresh and expose last-success context; retain enabled stale-cache saving and every retained panel.

findings.detail: Spend unavailable state explains the server cap continues, but provides no explicit retry although usageQuery.refetch is available. Stale notice also lacks independent recovery control.
findings.fix: Add existing localized Button retry for this source without blocking config saving or hiding the cap, and retain null rather than zero for unknown spend.

findings.detail: Whole summary is labeled unavailable when daily usage lacks data even if settings and three draft metrics are available. Spend missingReason only distinguishes off/loading, not initial failure; SettingsSummaryBrief accepts only aggregate unavailable/retained flags.
findings.fix: Preserve known configuration metrics and explicitly explain independent unavailable/retained spend via existing per-metric missingReason/context and summary source text. Do not substitute unavailable zeros or create a new stats owner.

visualIssues.detail: Helix selected mode cards inherit neonColorMap backgrounds/borders/dots (tokens.ts:21-26); shared focus also hardcodes cyan (RadioCard:76). Helix mode accents blue/green/cyan are categories rather than success/failure severity.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should offer subdued theme/control selected chrome and theme focus ring while preserving checked/native semantics and persisted theme IDs; page adopts approved neutral selection contract.
visualIssues.confidence: high source evidence; rendered intensity unverified

visualIssues.detail: Archive confirmation invents purple border/background and fixed purple icon for an informational consent prompt instead of existing neutral surface/semantic feedback chrome.
visualIssues.fix: Compose existing surface and feedback primitives with neutral hierarchy; preserve complete archive explanation/list, live-region announcement, explicit confirm/decline and stable test IDs.

visualIssues.detail: Full validation result text uses fixed emerald-300/rose-300; cap amount text likewise uses cyan-300/amber-300/rose-300 (AICostCapSpendBar:36-40,101). These do not follow primary/secondary body text across themes. Token documentation explicitly limits severity foreground to icons and small labels.
visualIssues.fix: Keep result/readout body text on existing theme text tokens; apply semantic hue to concise icon/badge accents, retaining textual OK/failure and cap warning/critical explanations. Measure actual contrast after implementation.
visualIssues.confidence: high source evidence; no contrast failure claimed

architectureIssues.detail: Every changed AI server snapshot resets mode/features/provider and clears restore dismissal. There is no dirty-draft guard, so an AI-subtree refresh during editing can overwrite unsaved local changes. This is a preservation risk, not permission to change query policy.
architectureIssues.fix: Feature owner should explicitly track draft/baseline and protect dirty edits on refresh, with focused tests for refresh versus save success; retain current cache keys, invalidation, explicit save and all provider merge/secret semantics.
architectureIssues.confidence: high source control flow; race not exercised
